p.n: The Philosopher Shows a Minor Animal to Sow Discord

body.p:
" Ichnelates said, "Don't you know, you fool, that
such an action would not be blameworthy What else is
more precious to a living creature than his own life For if
someone will not defend himself, he will hardly be protected
by anyone else. You've revealed the envy lurking within you,
and made it known to everyone that you're hostile and unre-
liable. so

you should give up loitering at the king's gate, for
someone like you isn't worthy to be anywhere near kings."

When he had heard this, the soldier left, looking dejected.
The lion's mother said to Ichnelates "I am astonished at
your recklessness, Ichnelates, and how, after having dared to
do this, you're insulting us with such words." But Ichnelates
replied, "Why are you looking at me through one eye, my
lady Don't you know that the minds of good people are easily
swayed, according to poetry But I see that all according to
the prophet, have turned aside, together they have gone wrong
and

body.p:

out of an excess of goodness, neither terrifies nor punishes
